Get dimensions of a GPU table

Source: R/tbl-gpu.R
dim.tbl_gpu.Rd

Returns the number of rows and columns in a GPU table. For a lazy table with pending operations the row count is that of the RESULT, so the plan is run on the GPU (compute(), nothing is copied to R and x itself is not changed). ncol()/NCOL() only need the column count, so they are answered from the schema without running anything.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
dim(x)

Arguments

x

A tbl_gpu object.

Value

An integer vector of length 2: c(nrow, ncol). The row count is NA for a table that has no GPU data yet, for ncol()/NCOL() of a lazy table with pending operations (which ignore it), and for a zero-column table whose row count was never recorded.

Examples

if (has_gpu()) {
  dim(tbl_gpu(mtcars))
}
#> [1] 32 11
